purpose: Teach: 鳳/鞘/英字/天秤/死語/有色/太もも/気密

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、神話の鳳凰研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, I see you covered phoenix mythology in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Slight rising intonation on the student's name. Steady, encouraging gaze. Genuine curiosity in the voice, not checking a box.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、日本刀の鞘職人研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the craftsmanship of sword sheaths instead.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slight pause before the pivot to show she's thought about this. Respectful but not deferential. A quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英字新聞の読解力研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I thought you chose English newspaper reading comprehension for your topic.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. A light questioning lilt at the end — not accusatory, more like 'let me check my notes.' Warm but present to what's being said.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、天秤量りの精度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I chose the precision of balance scales in measurement.
lines.style: Still respectful, but a touch firmer now. She's correcting gently. Eyes steady. Not defensive — just making sure the record is clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 死語化する若者言葉を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And for the third one, I recall you were researching obsolete youth slang.
lines.style: Leaning slightly forward. Curious, engaged tone. A small smile in the voice — the teacher who's genuinely interested in understanding what the student actually did.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、有色金属の精錬史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I actually researched the history of non-ferrous metal refining.
lines.style: Patient but clear. A thread of quiet amusement underneath — she's used to being misunderstood. The corrections come easily without any edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 太もも筋トレの効率を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Then the last one was about efficiency in lower body strength training, yes?
lines.style: Gentle, almost apologetic phrasing. Open posture — genuinely checking in. The voice softens slightly, like she's ready to listen to the actual answer this time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、気密性建築の換気を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I focused on ventilation systems in airtight construction.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered with quiet clarity. Soft but firm. A gentle close, like she's been patient and now the full picture is clear. No frustration, just precision.
